items.text: After 48 hours of extreme tension and apocalyptic threats from President Trump, a two-week truce has been reached. The deal requires the Strait of Hormuz to remain open under Iranian management, though Israel notes the agreement doesn’t include its operations in Lebanon. This diplomatic breakthrough was largely made possible by mediation from China and Pakistan, who stepped in while European leaders remained largely silent. However, critics within the European Parliament have attacked the EU’s top officials for ignoring the rising energy costs. Meanwhile, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte met Donald Trump, who has criticized allies for not supporting his stance on Iran. In Hungary, US Vice President JD Vance joined Viktor Orbán on the campaign trail and openly criticized Brussels for allegedly undermining Hungary’s economy. This visit coincides with leaked reports of a private phone call between Orbán and Vladimir Putin, which is causing further worries within the EU. Difficult words: apocalyptic (describing a very scary situation where the whole world or a country could be destroyed), truce (an agreement between two people or groups to stop fighting for a short time), stance (a person’s public opinion or official position on a specific topic), undermine (to make someone or something weaker or less effective, often in a secret way). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

President Donald Trump agreed to stop fighting with Iran for two weeks. Before this, Trump warned that a whole civilization might die, but he changed his mind just before a military deadline . The deal says that ships must be able to pass through the Strait of Hormuz, a very important water path for oil. But the peace is fragile because attacks are still happening in the region. In Europe, the leader of NATO visited Washington to talk to Trump about the future of NATO. Some experts believe that the US may leave NATO. Also, US Vice President JD Vance came to Hungary to support Viktor Orbán before an election. He told the media that the EU is trying to hurt Hungary’s economy. Some people are worried about Orbán’s friendly relationship with Russia. Difficult words: civilization (a large group of people living together with their own laws, culture, and history), deadline (a specific time or date by which you must finish or start something), fragile (something that is easily broken or damaged). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is big news about the US and Iran. They agree to stop fighting for two weeks. This is called a ceasefire. Many people are happy because they want the war to stop. But some people are still worried . At the same time, the leader of NATO comes to Washington to talk to President Trump. Some people believe that the US may leave NATO. In Hungary, there is an election soon. The US Vice President is there to help the Hungarian leader, Viktor Orbán. Some people in Europe are angry about this. They think that countries should not care about other countries’ elections. Difficult words: agree (to say yes), worried (when you are thinking about problems and things which may go wrong), election (when people choose a new leader). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The footwear market is changing fast as big brands like Nike and Crocs face new rivals . Nike is still the world’s largest sportswear company, but it has struggled lately. Analysts say Nike made a mistake by focusing too much on selling online and not enough on making new, exciting products. This allowed newer brands like Hoka and On Running to take many of Nike’s customers. Now, a new CEO, Elliott Hill, is trying to fix the company by focusing on sports again. Meanwhile, Crocs has made a huge comeback. People used to think Crocs were ugly, but clever marketing and colorful charms called Jibbitz made them cool for young people. Another big challenger is the Swiss company On Running, known for their unique shoes with hollow pads in the soles. On is growing very quickly. They even have a new spray-on technology to make shoes in just three minutes. However, all these brands face a new problem: high tariffs on shoes made in Vietnam, which could make sneakers much more expensive for everyone. Difficult words: rival (a person, team, or company that is competing with another for the same thing), charm (a small, decorative object that you can hang on a bracelet or push into the holes of a shoe), hollow (having a space or a hole inside; not solid). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The shoe business is changing. Nike, the biggest shoe brand , is having a hard time. For a few years, Nike didn’t create many new styles, so shoppers started buying shoes from other brands like Hoka and On. Now, Nike has a new boss who wants to make the brand special again. At the same time, Crocs are popular again. Many people thought they were ugly , but nowadays, you can decorate them with small charms . This helped them sell billions of dollars of shoes. A Swiss brand called On is also becoming a leader. Their shoes look very different and are popular with people who run. On is growing much faster than older brands. But there is a risk for the future. Many shoes come from Vietnam, and new taxes may make the price of shoes go up. Brands must find ways to stay popular even when prices are rising. Difficult words: brand (the name and image of a company), ugly (not pleasant to look at, not beautiful), charm (a small, decorative object). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The world of shoes is changing. Nike is the biggest company, but it has some problems. Many people are now buying shoes from new companies. Nike wants to make better shoes to get back its customers . Crocs are also very famous now. Children and young people love them. They are comfortable and fun to decorate. On is a new company from Switzerland. On is also doing very well. They make shoes which look very cool and are great for running. Shoes may cost more money soon. This is because of new taxes on shoes from other countries. All these companies want to be the best. They are working hard to make shoes which people love to wear every day. Difficult words: customer (a person who buys things or services from a shop or business), comfortable (when something feels good to your body), tax (money for the government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Wireless music festival in London has been cancelled after the UK government blocked American rapper Kanye West from entering the country. The festival’s organiser, Festival Republic, announced that all ticket holders will receive refunds. The government made this decision because of West’s past comments supporting Nazism and his anti-semitic remarks. British Prime Minister Keir Starmer stated that the artist should never have been invited to lead the festival. Many major companies also stopped supporting the event after West was named as the headline act . In the past, West has faced similar bans in other countries like Australia. Although the rapper recently apologized in a newspaper and blamed his behavior on health issues, the UK government didn’t change its mind. West offered to meet with Jewish groups in London to show he had changed, but he was still denied entry. People have different opinions on the news; some believe the government was right to stop him, while others think artists should be allowed to speak freely. Difficult words: anti-semitic (behavior or speech that is cruel or unfair to Jewish people), headline act (the most famous singer or band at a festival who performs last), deny (to say no to something or to not allow someone to have what they want). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A big music festival in the UK is not going to happen this year. The government told the famous rapper Kanye West that he cannot enter the country. Because he was the main star, the organizers had to cancel the whole event. The government blocked West because he said many bad things about Jewish people and praised Hitler in the past. Many big companies were angry and didn’t want to give money to the festival. Kanye West said sorry and told people he was sick, but the UK government still said no. Some people think the government is right because West is a bad example for young people. Others think it is wrong for the government to stop an artist. Everyone who bought a ticket will get their money back. Difficult words: enter (to come or go into a place), cancel (to decide that an organized event will not happen), praise (to say that someone or something is very good). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is no Wireless music festival in London this year. Why? Because the famous singer Kanye West cannot come to the UK. The government says that West must not come into the country. West says many bad and mean things in the past. He speaks about Hitler and Jewish people. Many people are angry. Kanye West says sorry. But the government still says no. Now, the festival is cancelled . If you have a ticket, you will get your money back. Some people are happy about this, but some people are sad. They think that it is a big problem for music. Difficult words: government (the group of people who make the rules and control a country), mean (not kind), cancelled (when somebody stops a plan or an event). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Swiss city of Lugano is home to one of the world’s most advanced supercomputers, called Alps. This supercomputer contains nearly 11,000 powerful processors, far stronger than a typical laptop. Alps operates sustainably by using cold water from Lake Lugano to cool down the machines, which produce a lot of heat. The water passes through heat exchangers and returns warmer to the lake without harming the environment. Each of the 2,688 computing blades inside has blue and red pipes for liquid cooling to avoid confusion during maintenance. Alps helps scientists process large datasets to predict global issues such as sea level rise, glacier melting, and extreme weather events. It runs complex AI models that simulate how rising CO2 levels affect the planet. Near Alps is the Contra Dam, where data on heavy rainfall and snow are studied. Alps uses millions of data points and thousands of altitude levels to perform calculations impossible for normal computers, providing critical insight for climate science. Difficult words: heat exchanger (a device that transfers heat), dataset (a large collection of data), altitude (height above sea level). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Lugano in Switzerland has a supercomputer called Alps, which is much stronger than a normal laptop. Alps uses cold water from Lake Lugano to cool the machines and protect the environment. The water cools the computers and then returns to the lake. The supercomputer has many parts called blades, cooled by pipes with colors to keep track of them during maintenance . Alps helps scientists predict problems like rising sea levels and extreme weather by running computer models. Near Alps is the Contra Dam, where scientists measure rain and snow. The supercomputer uses millions of data points and levels to study how the climate might change. Difficult words: keep track (to have information about something), maintenance (work to keep machines working well), measure (to find out the size or amount of something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Lugano, Switzerland, there is a strong computer called Alps. It is much stronger than a normal laptop. It helps scientists learn about weather problems like storms and ice melting . Alps uses cold water from a nearby lake to stay cool. The cold water flows through pipes , which cool the computer parts, and then goes back to the lake. Near the computer is a big dam called Contra Dam. Scientists check the rain and snow there. Scientists use the computer to understand weather changes. Difficult words: melt (when snow or ice changes into water), nearby (not far away), dam (a wall which holds back water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The war between the US and Iran is now in its second month. There is a lot of talk about the high cost of this conflict. In the first few days, the war cost over 11 billion dollars. This is because the US used many expensive missiles that cost 3.5 million dollars each. Experts say that by the 12th day, the US was spending 385 million dollars every day. This rate of spending is even higher than it was during the start of the wars in Iraq or Afghanistan. Because the war is taking place near important oil routes, the price of oil is rising around the world. In some places, oil prices are the highest they have been since 2008. This makes everything more expensive, from food to plane tickets. In Pakistan, the government had to raise petrol prices by 43% overnight. People are worried because no one knows when the war will end. At the same time, President Trump made a big change in his government by removing Pam Bondi from her job as Attorney General . Difficult words: missile (a powerful weapon that flies through the air and is sent to hit a specific target far away), a ttorney general (the most important lawyer in the government who is the leader of the country’s legal department). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The war between the USA and Iran is now in its second month. And it is very expensive. The US government is spending millions of dollars every day on weapons and ships. This war costs more money than the wars in Iraq or Afghanistan did at the start. In the first few days, the war cost over 11 billion dollars. The US used many rockets, which cost 3.5 million dollars each. Now, the US spends 385 million dollars every day. Because of the fighting, the price of oil is going up everywhere. When oil is expensive, the price of food and travel also goes up. For example, in Pakistan, petrol is now much more expensive than before. Many businesses are worried because they don’t know how long the war will continue. Difficult words: weapon (a gun or bomb), petrol (a fuel which people put in cars and trucks to make them move). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a war between the USA and Iran. It is now in its second month. The war costs a lot of money. The US uses many expensive rockets . One rocket costs 3.5 million dollars. Every day, the US spends 385 million dollars. Because of the war, oil is very expensive now. When oil costs more, food costs more, too. In countries like Pakistan, people must pay much more for petrol for their cars. Everyone is worried. They want the war to stop. Nobody knows when the war will end. Difficult words: expensive (when something costs a lot of money), rocket (an object which moves very fast through the air), petrol (a fuel which people put in cars and trucks to make them move). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Our planet is experiencing a powerful geomagnetic storm, the most potent in over two decades, which might disrupt power and communication systems worldwide. The sky has been illuminated with rare and vibrant colors, extending far beyond their usual polar locations. This phenomenon is caused by a large convergence of sunspots, which has produced several moderate to strong solar flares since Wednesday last week. Charged gas bubbles released from the Sun, known as Coral M injections, have created an extraordinary display in our ionosphere . The lights could be seen further south than usual, all over Europe and in the northern hemisphere. While visibility of the lights may vary by region, experts suggest that the most intense solar eruptions have already occurred. In our modern era, when we heavily rely on communication and space technologies, disruptions from geomagnetic storms are concerning. Difficult words: potent (having great power, influence, or effect), convergence (when two or more things come together or become similar), ionosphere (the part of the Earth’s atmosphere where ionization occurs). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Our planet is experiencing a powerful magnetic storm, the most powerful in over 20 years. The sky all over the northern hemisphere has rare and beautiful colors, which we don’t usually see so far from the poles. This event is happening because sunspots come together and they make a strong solar flare . Gas bubbles from the Sun are making a special show in the sky. Even though not everyone can see it, some people might get another chance to see the pretty lights in the sky. But the storm may not be so strong; therefore, the colors may be less bright. In our modern time, we use a lot of technology, which we depend on a lot. Experts worry that these storms may affect our technologies and cause disruptions . They may cause problems with power and communication. Difficult words: northern hemisphere (the northern half of Earth), flare (a sudden flame), disruption (problems which interrupt an event or activity). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Our world is having a powerful magnetic storm. It is the biggest in more than 20 years. How does the storm happen? There are unusual spots on the Sun. They come together. They make one big active area. Gas bubbles from the Sun are making a special show in the sky. People can see pretty lights in the sky. Because the storm is so big, people all over the northern hemisphere can see it. It is not usual. People can usually see Northern Lights around the poles. In our time now, we use a lot of technology. These storms can affect it. We may have problems with power, phones, or computers all over the world. Difficult words: powerful (strong), northern hemisphere (the northern half of Earth), affect (to have an impact on someone or something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Cambodia has revealed the world’s first statue of a rat named Magawa. This special rat was famous for finding landmines in the ground. Magawa was born in Tanzania and trained by a group from Belgium. During his career, he found over 100 landmines and other dangerous items. This helped make more than 141,000 square metres of land safe for people. Magawa was a very brave animal and even won a gold medal for his work. He died in 2022 when he was eight years old. The new statue in the city of Siem Reap shows Magawa wearing his medal and his work harness . Cambodia is still one of the most dangerous countries because of old mines from past wars. These mines can still hurt or kill people today. The government wants the country to be mine-free by the year 2030. This monument reminds the world that there is still a lot of work to do to keep people safe. Difficult words: landmine (a bomb hidden under the ground that explodes when someone steps on it or drives over it), harness (a set of straps that fits around an animal’s body so it can be held or controlled while working). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Cambodia, there is a new statue of a very brave rat. His name was Magawa. He was not a normal rat; he was a hero who found landmines. Landmines are dangerous things hidden under the ground that can explode. Magawa found more than 100 of these mines. This made the land safe for children and families. He worked for many years and even received a gold medal for his bravery . Magawa died in 2022, and now people made a stone statue to say thank you. The statue is in Siem Reap. Cambodia still has many mines from old wars, and the government wants to remove all of them by 2030. This statue helps people remember Magawa and the important work of keeping the country safe. Difficult words: hero (somebody who people like for doing something very brave or great to help others), bravery (doing something even when you are afraid), remove (to take something away). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Cambodia has a new statue of a rat. The rat’s name is Magawa. He is a very good and brave rat. He helps people. He looks for dangerous things in the ground. These things are called mines. Magawa finds 100 mines during his life. He saves many lives! He even gets a medal. People love Magawa. Magawa is dead now. He dies in 2022. People make a big statue of him. Cambodia still has dangerous mines in the ground. The government wants to find all of them. This statue is a thank you to the small rat. Difficult words: statue (a person or object from stone or metal), brave (when you are not afraid), dangerous (not safe). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

For six weeks each spring, many people in Greece and Orthodox communities follow a special diet called Lent . This traditional way of eating is like a modern detox for the body. During this time, millions of people stop eating meat, eggs, and dairy products. At the Monastery of St. Augustine and Seraphim, monks follow these rules very strictly. They mostly eat vegetables and legumes , like lentils. On weekdays, they even stop using olive oil. To make the food taste good, they use tahini on potatoes or make rich vegetable soup from scratch. Nutritionists say this practice is very healthy. It can help reduce cholesterol and manage blood sugar because people avoid unhealthy animal fats. However, experts warn that if the fast is too long, the body might need more vitamins like B12. For the monks, fasting is not just about health; it is like training for the soul. It helps them concentrate and feel closer to God. Even for those who are not monks, the fast is popular. Markets sell a lot of seafood, like octopus and shrimp, which are allowed during this time. Difficult words: Lent (a special period of 40 days before Easter when some people stop eating certain foods), legumes (beans, peas, and lentils), tahini (a thick paste made from crushed sesame seeds, often used instead of butter or oil). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Greece, many people follow a special food tradition every spring before Easter. For six weeks, they don’t eat meat, milk, or eggs. This is called a fast. Monks in Greek monasteries follow these rules every day. They eat a lot of vegetables, beans, and potatoes. On most days, they don’t even use oil. They say this helps their minds stay strong and quiet. Doctors say this way of eating is good for the heart. It helps lower weight and keeps the blood healthy. In the city, many people join the fast for at least one week. They buy seafood like shrimp or octopus because these are allowed. This tradition is a great way to clean the body and learn discipline . It is like a gym for the mind and the body. Difficult words: monk (a man who lives in a religious group away from other people and follows strict rules), monastery (the building or place where a group of monks lives and prays together), discipline (when you can control what you do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Greece, there is a special time in spring. People do not eat meat or milk for many days. This is a very old tradition. It is called Lent. Monks live in a house called a monastery. They eat only vegetables, fruit, and beans. They do not eat eggs. They say that this makes them feel good and strong. Doctors think that this is healthy for the body. It helps the heart and the blood. Many people in the city also do this before Easter. They buy fish and vegetables at the market . It is a good way to be healthy and think about God. Difficult words: monk (a man who lives in a religious group away from other people and follows strict rules), healthy (well and strong), market (a public place where people meet to buy and sell fresh food). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Céline Dion shared an exciting announcement video on her 58th birthday. She confirmed she will perform in Paris again starting this September. After dealing with serious health issues for several years, the famous singer told her fans that she is feeling good, singing, and even dancing again. She thanked her followers for their kindness and prayers ; she said their support helped her through her most difficult times. This comeback is very special because it happens two years after her emotional performance at the opening ceremony of the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. Back then, she sang from the Eiffel Tower, which was a very powerful moment for people all over the world. Céline described the chance to perform for her fans again as the best gift of her life. While she has had to keep her recovery a secret for some time, she is now ready to return to the stage. Her fans are very happy to hear that she is managing her health and doing great. Difficult words: prayer (the words someone says when they speak to God or hope very strongly for something good to happen), comeback (when a famous person starts working or performing again after being away for a long time), recovery (the time it takes to get healthy and strong again after being sick or hurt). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Famous singer Céline Dion has great news for her fans. On her 58th birthday, she made a video to say that she is coming back to Paris to perform in September. For a long time, Céline was seriously sick and couldn’t sing. But now, she says she is feeling good and is practicing her singing and dancing. She thanked her fans for all their love and prayers during her hard times. Two years ago, Céline sang at the Paris Olympic Games, and everyone was very happy to see her. Now, she is ready to give concerts again. She says that seeing her fans again is the best birthday gift in her life. Difficult words: perform (to sing, dance, or act in front of a group of people), seriously (when something is very important, true, or not a joke), prayer (the words someone says when they speak to God or hope very strongly for something good to happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Céline Dion is a very famous singer. It is her 58th birthday. She has a surprise for her fans . She says that she is feeling good. Céline is sick for a long time, but now she is better. She can sing and dance again. In September, she will go to Paris to have concerts. She loves her fans very much. Their love helps her when she is sad. Céline is very happy to see her fans again. It is a very happy day for music lovers. The best gift for Céline is to sing and see her fans again. Difficult words: surprise (an event or some news which you do not know about), fan (a person who loves and follows a singer, actor, or sports team), gift (a present). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Japanese police are starting to punish people who ride bicycles recklessly , following a record number of accidents that involved pedestrians . The new law went into effect last Wednesday across Japan. It allows officers to issue tickets and fines for breaking rules. These rules include small things, like holding an umbrella while riding, wearing earbuds, or not stopping at red lights. The highest fine, about 75 dollars, is for using a phone while cycling. Last year, there were more than 67,000 bicycle accidents. In many cases, the rider didn’t follow the rules. One victim was hit by a student on a bike, and her shoulder still hurts today. Some riders say the new rules about where to ride are confusing . However, the police hope these fines will make people more careful. These rules are for everyone who is 16 years old or older. If the mistake is very small, the police might only give a warning the first time. Difficult words: recklessly (in a dangerous way without thinking about the safety of other people), pedestrian (a person who is walking in the street), confusing (difficult to understand because it is not clear). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Japan, the police have new rules for people on bicycles. Last year, there were many accidents because cyclists didn’t follow the law. Now, if you do something dangerous, the police can give you a blue ticket, and you must pay a fine . For example, you cannot use a phone or hold an umbrella while you ride. You must also stop at red lights and stay off the sidewalk in some areas. Many people are buying raincoats now because they cannot use umbrellas anymore. The police want everyone to be safe, especially people who are walking. If you are 16 or older, you must follow these rules or pay a fine. Difficult words: fine (an amount of money you must pay for breaking a rule or law), sidewalk (the path next to the road for people to walk on), raincoat (a special coat that you wear to stay dry when it is raining). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Japan has new rules for bicycles. Many people ride bikes in Japan. Sometimes it is dangerous . Now, the police are watching. You cannot use your phone on a bike. You cannot hold an umbrella in the rain. If you break a rule, you must pay money. This money is called a fine. The police want to help people who are walking. One woman has a collision with a bike. Her shoulder still hurts. These new rules are for everyone who is 16 years or older. People must be careful and follow the signs. Difficult words: dangerous (not safe), umbrella (a tool which you hold over your head when it rains), collision (a crash). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Michael Cavaliere, a staff member at the Wild Bird Fund, spends his time rescuing and rehabilitating injured pigeons in New York City. Although many people consider pigeons to be pests , Michael sees them as creatures struggling to survive in a difficult urban environment. One of the biggest dangers they face is a string foot. This happens when discarded human hair or strings wrap tightly around a bird’s toes, which causes severe injuries, infections, or even the loss of their feet. Michael explains that some birds have minor problems and can be treated and released immediately on the street. However, more serious cases require a trip to a vet, where the birds might need surgery or anesthesia to save their lives. Pigeons in the city face many challenges, including pollution, traffic, and a lack of food. For Michael, something as simple as cutting a thread can give a bird its life back. He believes it is important for humans to help animals that cannot help themselves. Difficult words: rehabilitate (to help a person or animal live a normal life again after an injury), pest (an animal or insect that causes problems for people, usually by damaging food or buildings), discard (to throw something away because you do not want it or do not need it anymore). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In New York City, a man named Michael Cavaliere helps injured pigeons. Many people don’t like pigeons, but Michael thinks they are special. The birds often get human hair or string caught around their feet. This is very dangerous because it can cut their skin or make them lose their toes. Michael catches the birds and cuts the string. If the injury is small, the bird can fly away immediately . If the injury is bad, he takes the bird to a vet. Michael says that life in the city is very hard for birds because of cars and pollution . He wants to help them because they are small and cannot help themselves. Difficult words: string (a long, thin piece of material used for tying things together), immediately (right now), pollution (dirty water, land, or air). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Michael lives in New York. He loves birds, mainly pigeons . Life in a big city is hard for pigeons. They have no food, and there are many cars. Sometimes, hair or string gets around a bird’s foot. This hurts the bird very much. Michael finds these birds and helps them. He cuts the string with scissors . Then the bird can fly and be happy again. Some birds are very sick, so they go to an animal doctor. Michael says that we must be kind to animals. It is a very good thing to help a small bird stay alive. Difficult words: pigeon (a grey bird which lives in cities and parks), string (a long, thin piece of material), scissors (a tool which we use to cut paper, cloth, or string). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Hello students, We have a website for you. Its name is www.videosinlevels.com . We want to help you by providing materials for your listening practice. We choose interesting videos from YouTube and we put them on Videos in Levels. We choose videos for six levels of difficulty. The concept is a little bit different than News in Levels because every video is only in one level. There are videos on many topics, such as songs, films, hobbies, nature, interesting people and also videos in simplified English . Have a nice day, News in Levels team

We choose videos for six levels. There are videos about hobbies, nature, interesting people, songs, films and also videos in simplified English . Have a nice day, News in Levels team

Trading cards, especially Pokémon, have transformed from childhood hobbies into serious financial investments. In February 2026, a rare Charizard card sold for a record-breaking 16.5 million dollars. Between 2020 and 2025, spending on non-sports cards increased by 350%, which sometimes even beat the stock market’s returns. Many kidults (adults who buy toys) are now using their disposable income to build collections as alternative assets or emergency funds. To determine a card’s value, owners use a process called grading. Professional companies examine the card’s condition; a pristine 10 grade can make a card worth thousands more than a lower grade. However, experts warn that this market could be a bubble, similar to the Beanie Baby fad of the 1990s. If people lose interest or if cards are overproduced, prices could crash. Despite these risks, the market is currently booming, and many collectors enjoy owning physical pieces of their childhood nostalgia while hoping their value continues to grow. Difficult words: disposable income (the extra money you have left to spend after you pay for important things like food and rent), pristine (in perfect condition), fad (something that is very popular for a very short time), nostalgia (a feeling of happiness and a little bit of sadness when you remember good times from your past). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Old Pokémon cards cost a lot of money now. One card sold for almost 17 million dollars in 2026! Many adults are now buying these cards as an investment , like gold for example. To know the price, you must send your card to a company for grading. They look at the card very closely. If the card is perfect, it gets a 10 and is very expensive. People like cards because they can hold them in their hands and remember the times when they were kids. But investing in cards is risky . Sometimes the market crashes, and the cards become worthless . But for now, the business is growing fast, and some people even use card money to pay for school or pension. Difficult words: investment (something you buy so you can sell it for more money later), risky (dangerous or uncertain), worthless (something what costs no money). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Do you have old Pokémon cards? Well, you may sell them for a lot of money! In 2026, one man sells a card for 16.5 million dollars. Many adults now buy these cards. They want to be rich. They send their cards to a big office. The office looks at the card and gives it a number. A 10 is a perfect card. It is fun to collect cards, but it is also a game with money. Sometimes the price goes up, and sometimes it goes down. You must be careful ! But many people love their cards because they are beautiful and famous. When people look at some cards, they remember the times many years ago. Difficult words: adult (someone who is not a child anymore), collect (to buy and keep similar things), careful (when you do something and you think a lot about it so nothing goes wrong). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Four masked thieves have stolen millions of euros’ worth of art from the Magnani Rocca Foundation, a museum near Parma, Italy. The gang entered the villa on March 22 and took three famous paintings by Renoir, Cézanne, and Matisse. The entire heist was incredibly fast; it lasted only three minutes. Although the museum’s alarm system stopped them from taking more items, the thieves managed to escape before the police arrived. Experts are concerned that this might be a copycat crime following a famous robbery at the Louvre in Paris last year. Because the museum is located in the countryside, it was an attractive target for the criminals. Art recovery specialists say that only 5% to 10% of stolen art is ever found. It is very difficult for thieves to sell famous paintings because the police and the media watch for them globally. This event has started a serious discussion about how to improve security in smaller, rural museums. Difficult words: entire (all of something; the whole part of a thing), heist (a grand robbery, usually from a museum or bank), copycat (a person who does the same thing as someone else, or a crime that is an exact copy of a famous one). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Four men with masks robbed a museum in Italy. They stole three very expensive paintings by famous artists like Matisse and Renoir. The paintings are worth more than 9 million euros. The thieves were very fast; they were inside the museum for only three minutes. The alarm started to ring, so the men ran away with only three pictures. This museum is in the countryside, far from the city, so the thieves thought it was easy to rob it. Experts say it is very hard to find stolen art. Only about 10% of stolen paintings ever come back to the museum. Now, many people are worried about museum safety. They think other criminals might try to steal from small museums, too. Difficult words: rob (to take money or things from a place), worth (how much money you can get if you steal something), stolen (when a thief takes something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Four thieves get into a museum in Italy. They wear masks. No one can see their faces. They steal three beautiful paintings. These paintings are very expensive and famous. The men are very quick. They are in the museum for only three minutes. The museum alarm makes a loud noise. The men run away. The police arrive in four minutes, but the men are away. Now, the police are looking for the paintings. It is very difficult to find stolen paintings. Only about 10% of stolen paintings ever come back to museums. Many people are sad because these paintings are important for the history of Italy. Difficult words: thief (a person who takes something what is not theirs), steal (when you take something what is not yours), stolen (when a thief takes something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Sweden, once known for being very open, now has some of the strictest migration policies in Europe. A new law passed by the conservative government is causing many young people to be deported, even if they grew up in Sweden, speak the language, and have jobs or partners there. The Swedish Migration Authority says that once a person turns 18, they are adults and no longer need their family’s protection, even if their parents have permanent residency . The media have reported on extreme cases, such as an 8-month-old baby receiving a deportation notice . Many of those being sent away, like Nardin, Isa, and Batis, are terrified to return to countries like Iran or Egypt, where they may face danger or discrimination. While thousands of Swedes have protested in 30 cities to support these young people, the Swedish Parliament recently rejected a plan to stop the deportations. The government argues that these tough rules are necessary and bring Sweden in line with the rest of Europe. Difficult words: conservative (a political group that usually likes to keep traditional rules and can be very strict about new changes or migration), permanent residency (an official document or status that allows a person from another country to live and work in a new country forever), deportation notice (an official letter from the government telling a person that they must leave the country by a certain date). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Sweden has new, very tough rules for people from other countries. Many young people who are 18 or 21 years old must now leave Sweden. They must go to countries like Iran or Egypt, even if they lived in Sweden for a long time. These young people speak Swedish, they study, and they work as nurses or in other jobs. The government says that at 18, you are an adult , so you don’t need to stay with your parents. This is very sad because families can’t stay together. In one case, a baby got a letter to leave the country. Many Swedish people are angry and are protesting in the streets to help. They want the government to change the law. But the government says the new rules are important for the country. Difficult words: tough (very hard, strong, or strict), nurse (a person whose job is to care for sick or injured people, usually in a hospital), adult (not a child). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Sweden has a new law . Many young people must leave the country. They are 18 or 19 years old. They live in Sweden, they go to school, and they have friends there. But the government says they must go back to countries like Iran. These young people are very afraid. They want to stay with their mothers and fathers in Sweden. The government says that these people do not need to stay with their parents in Sweden. Many people in Sweden walk in the streets. They want to help the families. But the government says no. It is a very difficult time for these young students. They hope that they can stay in their homes. Difficult words: law (official rules in a country), government (people who control a country), parents (your mother and father). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Tracking children’s locations and monitoring their online activity has become more common among parents, raising questions about its effects on children’s independence. While some kids feel safer knowing someone is watching, others feel restricted, especially when parental controls limit their use of certain apps and websites. Adolescents often find ways to bypass these controls, sometimes making them less safe as they hide their activities from their parents. Experts say that strict monitoring can damage trust and increase rebellious behavior. Parents are advised to have open conversations with their children about technology instead of only relying on controls. By teaching self-regulation and smart decision-making, parents can help kids navigate the digital world responsibly. Some teens believe that by the age of 16, they should have the right to decide whether they are tracked . Difficult words: bypass (to find a way around), rebellious (acting against control), tracked (followed). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many parents now check their children’s locations and online activities to keep them safe. Some children feel okay with this, as it makes them feel safe. But others feel their parents control them too much, which impacts their social lives or schoolwork. Some teenagers find ways to get around these controls, which can make things worse. Experts say that when parents are too strict, kids may rebel and break the rules. It is better to talk with children openly about technology and teach them to choose carefully what they do. As children grow older, they should learn to be responsible online, and parents should stop monitoring them. Some teens think they should stop being tracked by the time they are 16. Difficult words: location (where someone or something is), rebel (to act against control), monitor (to check). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Parents often use apps to control their kids. Parents want to know where their children are and what they are doing. Some kids like this. It makes them feel safe. But other kids feel too much control. They find ways to hide what they do. Experts say that it is better to talk to kids. Parents should teach them how to be safe online. If parents are too strict, kids may break the rules. As kids get older, they need more freedom . They want to do things which they like. Some teens think that when they are 16 years old, they should tell their parents to stop controlling them. Difficult words: control (to say what someone can or cannot do), hide (to keep away from other people), freedom (when you can do what you want). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A study from the Australian National University has shown that surfing adds around 2 billion dollars to Australia’s economy annually. However, experts warn that surf breaks, where waves form, need more legal protection. Climate change, coastal erosion , and increasing competition for coastal spaces threaten these natural sites. While countries like New Zealand and Peru have already taken legal steps to protect their surf areas, Australia hasn’t yet done the same. Surfing has both social and economic value in Australia, and its long coastline attracts both surfers and tourists. Local businesses, like cafes, surf shops, and accommodations, benefit from the surfing culture. The sport’s popularity spans from beginners to experienced surfers, and many people enjoy being outdoors and near the ocean. For many, surfing is not just a hobby but a way to connect with nature, which needs better protection. Difficult words: erosion (the slow destruction of land due to natural forces), span (to extend across a period or a range of subjects). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A new study from the Australian National University says that surfing brings about 2 billion dollars into Australia’s economy every year. But surf breaks, the areas where waves form , are at risk. Things like climate change and coastal erosion make the waves weaker, and more need for space near the coast makes it worse. While countries like New Zealand and Peru have laws to protect surfing areas, Australia hasn’t. Surfing is very popular in Australia and has social and economic value . Tourists and locals love to surf, and many businesses near the beaches benefit from this. From beginners to professionals, surfing is a big part of life in Australia, and people enjoy the connection it gives them to nature. Difficult words: form (to make or create), erosion (the slow destruction of land by wind and water), value (when something is very important or useful). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Surfing is a popular sport in Australia. Every year, it brings about 2 billion dollars to the country’s economy . Surf breaks are the places where the waves form . These areas are in danger . Things like climate change and problems with the coast are bad for these areas. Countries like New Zealand and Peru have rules. They look after the surf breaks. But Australia needs to do more. Surfing is important because it helps the economy. It makes people happy, too. Many people, from beginners to experts, love to surf. Businesses near the beach make money from it. Surfing is special because it brings people closer to nature. Difficult words: economy (the system of money in a country), form (to make or create), danger (a situation where something bad can happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Stephen McCullagh, a YouTube content creator, has been found guilty of murdering his pregnant partner, Natalie McNally. To hide the crime, he created an elaborate fake alibi using a six-hour video game live stream. On the night of the murder, his subscribers watched him play games and drink, but the video was actually recorded four days earlier. McCullagh told viewers he couldn’t reply to comments due to technical problems, so they wouldn’t realize it was not live. While the video played, he traveled to Natalie’s home and attacked her. For six weeks after the crime, he acted like a grieving boyfriend, attended her funeral, and even visited her grave. However, police eventually took his computer and discovered his lies. The court heard that jealousy might have been the motive , as Natalie was considering breaking up with him. McCullagh will be sentenced later this year. Difficult words: elaborate (detailed and complicated), alibi (proof that someone was in a different place when a crime happened), motive (the reason why a person does something, especially why they commit a crime). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Stephen McCullagh killed his partner, Natalie, who was pregnant. He tried to trick the police with a very clever plan. He put a long video of himself playing games on YouTube. People thought the video was live, but it was recorded before. While people watched the video, Stephen went to Natalie’s house and killed her. After the murder, Stephen pretended to be very sad. He cried and talked to Natalie’s family. He thought his plan was perfect, but the police found the truth on his computer. They saw that his YouTube stream was a lie. The jury found him guilty of murder. This story shows that even a computer cannot hide a crime from the police forever. Difficult words: trick (to make someone believe something that is not true so you can get what you want), pretend (to behave as if something is true when you know that it is actually not), guilty (when a judge or jury says that a person officially did a crime ). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Stephen McCullagh is a famous YouTuber. He kills his girlfriend, Natalie. He tries to hide the truth. He puts a video on the internet. He wants people to think he is at home playing games. But the video is old. Stephen goes to Natalie’s house while the video is on YouTube. He looks sad after the murder . He tells the police a lie. But the police are clever. They look at his computer. They see that the video is old. Stephen is not a good man; he is a murderer. Now, he must go to jail . Natalie’s family is very sad, but they are happy that the police find the truth. Difficult words: hide (to put something in a place where other people cannot see it or know about it), murder (killing another person), jail (a building where you stay if you do something very bad). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Young people in London are trying a creative new way to find love called Date My Mate . Instead of using dating apps, which many find boring or negative, singles go to a pub where their best friends give a PowerPoint presentation about them. These pitches last about two minutes and include fun facts, nice photos, and jokes to help their friend find a partner. The event is extremely popular; recently, 150 tickets sold out in just five minutes. Organizers say that usage of the ten biggest dating apps fell by 16% in the last year, showing that people want to return to traditional places like pubs, but with a modern, funny twist . This format allows friends who are already in relationships to help their single mates in a supportive environment. It turns the horrible stories of online dating into a fun social night. After seeing success in the US and Australia, these events are now expected to happen weekly across the UK. Difficult words: pitch (a short speech to persuade someone), usage (using something or the amount that something is used), twist (a new or unexpected way of doing something that makes it more interesting). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many young people in London are tired of dating apps like Tinder. They think swiping on a phone is not a good way to meet a boyfriend or girlfriend. Now, they are going to Date My Mate nights at the pub. At these events, a person stands up and shows a presentation about their single friend. They show photos and tell the crowd why their friend is great. For example, one friend joked that her mate is an engineer, so she can support a partner. These events are very popular, and tickets sell out very fast. People like this because it is more fun than an app, and their friends can help them find love. It is a new way to meet real people in a real place. Difficult words: swipe (to move your finger quickly across the screen of a phone), presentation (a talk where you show information, pictures, or ideas to a group of people on a screen), crowd (a large group of people in one place, like a pub or a concert). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people do not like dating apps on their phones anymore. They want to meet new people in a pub. In London, there is a new game called Date My Mate . A friend speaks to a big group of people. They show pictures and tell stories about their single friend. It is like a small school lesson, but for love. Many people go to these events because they are fun. They laugh and drink wine with their friends. There is a problem with some dating apps. People are sad when they use them. Meeting in a pub is a better way to find a friend or a partner. It is a very happy night for everyone. Difficult words: dating app (a program on a phone where people meet new people and try to find a boyfriend or girlfriend), single (a person who is not married and does not have a partner), laugh (the sound you make when something is very funny). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
